question: For what purpose is the purification aimed at faults from beginningless existence?
premises: Faults are described as arising from beginningless existence
All such faults are in view
The rite aims at their calming
inference: The purification is performed for the calming of all faults arisen from beginningless existence.
plain_english: For the calming of all faults that have arisen from beginningless existence.
